route_qa.method: triangle-swept: every triangle densely sampled (barycentric grid, spacing <= 0.20 studs, so true clearance >= reported - 0.12) and measured against each walkway segment: (a) prior corridor volume (half-width hw about the centreline, walk band -1..+10) and (b) swept player capsule r=2.0, 5.5 tall, centre path within hw-2 of the centreline.

tee_visibility.method: vertices (<=400 per mesh) inside the ship_tee camera frame (90 deg h-fov, 1600x1000) and with an unobstructed ray from the tee eye (Tee1 + 5 up)

coplanar.method: face centre within 0.03 of another visual mesh, |dot|>0.995, plane gap <0.02 (prior method)

belly.profile: f = 1 + 0.16 * sin^2(pi*(Y-(-8))/(22)) * gX(x); peak at world Y3.0; 0 at/below Y-8 and at/above Y14 (deck Y24 untouched)
belly.x_taper: same as v5: 1.0 for x in [-130,105]; stern end 0.35 at x-160; bow fades to 0 by x150
